about_the_game:
Seeking shelter from the scorching heat in the nearest convenience store seemed like a great idea. And here is the result: a locked door, an unfamiliar interior, and... her. Petite, with short black hair, in a simple t-shirt and jeans, but with a gaze that sends shivers down your spine

"Well, hello there, boy. Ingratitude has never done anyone any good. I could have just taken something from you and left you on the street... but I didn't. So now you're my... guest"

The door is slammed shut, the key is hidden "between the hills", and your new acquaintance hints that it would be nice for you to repay her in some way. How will this forced visit end?

What awaits you?

  • An Escape Attempt — The doors are magical, the windows don't open, and the local "hostess" just chuckles. Will you find a loophole... or do you no longer need one?

  • Amusing Dialogues — "Goth Mommy," "pet," "hot boy"... She clearly enjoys your embarrassment

  • A Touch of Magic — She claims she "worked a spell" on you. And for some reason, you believe her when your body suddenly stops obeying you, rain starts pouring outside, and your legs carry you straight to her warm bed on their own

  • A Surprise Ending — Will you stay in the role of a house pet, find a way to break free... or is a good ending in store? A visual novel about how a single black currant ice cream can turn your whole life upside down

    "So, hero, ready to play by my rules? Or should I... help you choose?"

content_descriptors.notes: Tha game contain revealing outfits and sex-related language
